### 2026-10-13 – I spent the first 2 hours of this week looking for components that I could use and how they would all be put together. Right now, my main idea is to make the screen attach to the back via a USB-C cabl

**2h**

I spent the first 2 hours of this week looking for components that I could use and how they would all be put together. Right now, my main idea is to make the screen attach to the back via a USB-C cable, and the power bank on the side. I will need to find a power bank that can support this computer, and also a keyboard.I also still need to find the key keyboard for this and start my design.
